description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of emotional categories present in a dataset of emotional speech. The chart contains six slices, each representing a different emotion: Neutral, Happiness, Sadness, Excitement, Anger, and Frustration. The slices are colored blue, green, purple, red, orange, and yellow, respectively. Percentage labels are displayed within each slice, indicating the proportion of each emotion: Neutral accounts for 23.1%, Happiness for 8.1%, Sadness for 25.1%, Excitement for 14.1%, Anger for 14.7%, and Frustration for 14.9%. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, starting with Neutral and generally decreasing in size. A legend labels each slice with its corresponding emotion. No slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding.
